environment.description: Service deployed on ECS Fargate task in a private subnet (10.0.128.0/20) within a VPC that has NO NAT Gateway, NO VPC endpoints for any service other than ECR (for image pull), and NO Internet Gateway route in the subnet's route table. The only ingress path is through an internal NLB (scheme=internal) accessible exclusively from a separate 'api-gateway' subnet via a VPC endpoint for execute-api. The Fargate task ENI has no public IP assignment. The subnet's route table entry is local-only (10.0.0.0/16 -> local). There is a VPC Flow Log confirming zero egress traffic to non-RFC1918 destinations. Security group on the Fargate task allows inbound only from the NLB security group on port 8080 and denies all outbound except TCP/443 to the ECR VPC endpoint prefix list.

config.vpc_subnet: private 10.0.128.0/20, no IGW route, no NAT-GW
config.nlb_access: only from execute-api VPC endpoint in api-gateway subnet
config.flow_logs: enabled, confirms 0 packets to non-10.0.0.0/16 destinations
config.api_gateway_config: REST API with 10 req/sec throttle, API key required, usage plan enforced
